Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-17

1. Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
OpenAI introduced GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, the next generation of its language models, now available across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the public API.

2. Put Gemini to work for you
Google announced that the Tasks feature in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries. New functionality launches first in the United States, and deeper integration with Google Workspace lets the AI act on your behalf.

3. A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
Researchers presented a candidate non‑perturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and employed GPT‑6 Astra to generate and verify the detailed mathematical proof.
